prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Split layout adoption certificate redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a split layout to showcase the pet preview on one side and official adoption details on the other.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "body": "Your new desktop pet is registered and ready to join your workspace."}}
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pet interaction sound feedback preview: Add a pet sound preview component to the friend picker step so users can sample pet voice audio before selecting.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "sound", "label": "Listen to voice", "asset": "asset:voice_sample_1", "action": "play"}]}}
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet habit profile builder screen: Insert a new pet habit selection screen (new_pet_habits) before adoption certificate where users set active workspace hours for their pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_habits", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_habits": {"headline": "Set Pet Active Hours", "body": "Choose when your desktop companion is active during your work day.", "layout": "grid"}}
3: [choose_path, redesign] Carousel layout story intro screen redesign: Redesign the story intro screen into a multi-card carousel format explaining the pet app concept.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Swipe through to discover how your desktop pet lives alongside your work."}}
4: [sign_in, redesign] Two-column login layout for account persistence: Redesign the sign-in screen into a two-column layout explicitly presenting login options alongside account persistence safeguards.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Sign In to Preserve Your Pet", "body": "Connect your account to store pet traits and prevent data loss across sessions."}}
5: [finish, hint] Desktop pet shortcut key hint on home intro: Add a clear keyboard shortcut hint on the home intro screen detailing how to summon or unhide the pet on desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "If your pet wanders off screen, press Ctrl+Shift+P to center it on your desktop."}}
6: [sign_in, copy] Account session preservation copy on sign-in: Update sign-in headline and body to emphasize automated cloud memory sync to reassure returning users.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Cloud Save & Sync Protection", "body": "Signing in anchors your pet status to the cloud so your companion never resets."}}
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop controls waiting screen tip: Display a helpful wait tip detailing mouse click and right-click interaction options while waiting.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick options and actions."}}
8: [home, notification] Notify when pet asset unpacking completes: Enable system notification dispatch when the waiting screen completes background file unpacking.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "body": "Your pet files are ready! Click to view your new companion."}}
9: [finish, copy] Pet interaction gesture guide on home intro: Update the home intro body copy with basic mouse gesture instructions for moving and feeding the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Welcome Your Desktop Friend", "body": "Drag your pet to move it across monitors. Right-click to trigger treats, games, and options."}}
